card: background-color: #fbf7f0; border: 1px dashed #d8cbb8; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px 20px; margin: 0 0 32px

h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #5c4033; margin: 24px 0 12px; text-align: left
